_written: 2026-11-18, before any v1 scoring. Video-Index videos are evaluation-only: nothing below is tuned on them.

backends.glance-clip: Glance-4B-preview, LoRA on, typed yes/no head (calibrated temperature as shipped), block-bidirectional question block; the clip = 4 consecutive frames as a multi-image prefix (Glance only supports images)
backends.qwen-clip: same weights with the LoRA disabled (= base Qwen3.5-4B), causal question block, P(yes) = softmax over logsumexp{yes,Yes} vs logsumexp{no,No} of the LM head at the answer position; identical multi-image prefix
backends.qwen-video (optional): base Qwen3.5-4B through the HF processor's native video input (4 frames as one video), same yes/no readout

count_rule.count: number of hysteresis segments of P(t) after merging segments closer than merge_gap_s
count_rule.scoring: exact = primary count == key count; within1 = |primary - key| <= 1

choose.slice: 100 v1.0 items not in v1.1, random.Random(0).sample(sorted ids, 100)
choose.v0-frame: Glance choice head on 32 uniform single frames, mean of option probabilities (= v0 choose)
choose.glance-clip: Glance choice head on 8 uniform 4-frame clips, mean of option probabilities
choose.qwen-clip: base Qwen3.5-4B letter logprob (A..) on the same 8 clips, prompt identical to Glance's choice block, mean
choose.report: accuracy and argmin accuracy, by capability group
